entries.zh: 合卖：合伙出卖、共同售卖
entries.en: to sell jointly, in partnership; joint sale
entries.notes: L 栏 bender 为 17 世纪拼写之 vender（卖），与 H/M 相证；necesario es 短语部分与合卖之义未完全对应

entries.zh: 家用：家中日常所需与开支
entries.en: household use; domestic necessaries, household expenses
entries.notes: L 栏 de la capa 疑为 de la casa（家中）之误读，释义依 H/M

entries.zh: 所用个物：维持人生所需之物、生活必需品
entries.en: things needed for daily use; necessaries of human life

entries.zh: 尽皆：全都、统统（凡所需者尽皆如此）
entries.en: all, everything; entirely, altogether

entries.zh: 昏（昬）：昏昧愚钝；昏暗不明
entries.en: dull-witted, ignorant; dim, obscure
entries.notes: M 栏含西文夹注（mui obscuro… gargazon），夹注后半无法逐字解读，释义以 H/L 为据

entries.zh: 顽固：愚顽固执、冥顽不明事理
entries.en: obstinate, stubborn; thick-headed, dull of understanding

entries.zh: 癃龙：衰惫昏钝、老迈昏聩
entries.en: feeble and dull; sluggish, benighted
entries.notes: 癃 本义衰病，与词头 necio 之关联依赖推断（或含老迈昏聩义）

entries.zh: 朽：腐朽；喻不可造就之愚钝（朽木不可雕）
entries.en: rotten, decayed; (metaph.) hopeless and unteachable
entries.notes: H 栏字符标 [疑:朽/私]，以朽为据

entries.zh: 痴：痴愚呆傻、天真无知
entries.en: foolish, silly; simple-minded, ignorant

entries.zh: 蠢：愚笨迟钝、冥顽
entries.en: stupid, witless; slow-witted

entries.zh: 锢：顽锢不化，虽加教诲亦不能学
entries.en: obdurate — does not learn even when taught; sealed, impervious (mind)
entries.notes: H 键 M cõ 与词头义（虽教不学）之对应依赖推断

entries.zh: 愚暗：愚昧昏暗、冥顽无知
entries.en: foolish and benighted; dim-witted

entries.zh: 不明：不明事理、不明白
entries.en: not clear-minded; dull of comprehension

entries.zh: 雍龙人：愚钝之人〔该条字符与词头对应不明，暂依 necio 词头释义〕
entries.en: a dull, foolish person (character reading uncertain)
entries.notes: H 雍龍 与 M āng-lang 对应不明，仅依词头 necio 暂释

entries.zh: 腹内有：腹中壅滞昏愚〔字义与词头对应欠明，暂依 necio/fonso 词头释义〕
entries.en: 'has (something) in the belly' — understood as inward dullness; precise sense uncertain
entries.notes: M 栏 pā 与 H 有 音写不合，且西文 fonso（或 sonso，痴愚）未明，暂承词头释义

entries.zh: 心迷暗：心智迷乱昏暗（愚昧不明）
entries.en: mind beguiled and dark; befuddled, coarse-witted

entries.zh: 肚内无膏：肚里没有油膏，喻腹中空空、毫无学识
entries.en: 'no grease in the belly' — empty-headed, utterly without learning

entries.zh: 肚内极暗：肚里极其昏暗，喻愚昧至极
entries.en: 'utterly dark inside the belly' — profound ignorance

entries.zh: 土儓：乡野愚夫、土包子〔M 栏后半污损难辨〕
entries.en: rustic boor, bumpkin (latter part of M column smudged/illegible)
entries.notes: tone_marks_M 记 T99（污損難辨）且 H 标 [疑:儓/㑸]，仅前半 tor-hân 可据

entries.zh: 土人：乡愚、土包子；亦可指本地土著
entries.en: rustic, bumpkin; (also) native, unrefined person

entries.zh: 顽蠢：愚顽蠢笨
entries.en: obstinate and stupid; thick-witted
